comparison.objective: Mount a phone in a sprung car holder and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Open or oppose sprung arms, center and seat a phone, then establish edge clamping versus bimanual screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Holder arms clamp phone edges, phone is seated/still, hands clear for 1 s; drops fail.
comparison.reason: Tests spring-clamp insertion and seating, not many-body filtration.
